sentences.en: You've worked hard for months and have certainly earned a holiday.
sentences.zh: 你辛苦工作了好几个月，确实应该休息一下。

sentences.en: I enjoyed the holiday all the better for being with you.
sentences.zh: 有你在身边，这次假期我过得更开心。

sentences.en: It will do you good to have a holiday.

senses.zh: 假日，节日；假期，休假；休息，放松
